description: [mutate] Go somewhere, do something, come back with a result.

at.description: Send at an ISO time or after a duration such as 2h.

due.description: Expire this long after the card is shown, e.g. 30m.

goal.description: Goal id this call serves. Omit for a single call.

label.description: Tag for since() counting, e.g. sat-drill.

priority.description: Opportunistic waits for the unit to pick up the phone, standard shows now, preempt interrupts.

sudo.description: The unit's word does not settle this call: "done" needs evidence, "cannot" gets checked. Slower, and the unit dislikes it. Use it when a decision rides on the result.

task.description: What to do or get there. Imperative.

unit.description: Unit name or id. Required when more than one unit is paired.

wait.description: Block for the result: a duration ("90s", "10m") or "done". Omit when the next step does not need the answer. If "done" reaches the host's call limit it returns the open job: call the wait tool with the same job to keep waiting. In a background pass nothing blocks: the call returns at once and the runtime wakes the goal when the job settles.

name: errand
